name: Last Vesper
age: Age unknown; first recorded 241 years ago
description: The final note of a funeral hymn given a body. It drifts through the last antechamber, unraveling curses that interrupt its endless song.

abilities.description: Clears existing conditions and elemental traces at the start of every 3th round, before fresh applications.
Reflects 2 magical damage once when the combined direct attack damages it. Ward can absorb this.
